title: The 12 Best Hand Mixers of 2026
metaDescription: Our 12 picks for hand mixers of 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at hand mixers of 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: KitchenAid 5-Speed Ultra Power Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-speed slide switch with locking positions, Single-button beater eject, Spiral wire twin beaters covering ~90% of bowl wall radius.
strengths: Best beater bowl coverage in its price range, zero manual scrapes across a 3-minute pound cake cycle
2.4 lb weight avoids arm fatigue during 8-minute meringue sessions
Motor holds speed under medium cookie dough load without bogging
Single-button beater eject is smooth and consistent
Slide switch locks at each speed to prevent accidental changes
limitations: Only 5 speeds, less granular than 9-speed rivals for meringue building
features: Spiral wire twin beaters covering ~90% of bowl wall radius
Bowl-rest notch for resting on rim while adding ingredients

products.name: Cuisinart HM-90S Power Advantage Plus 9-Speed Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 9-speed rotary dial with labeled positions, 220W rated motor, 2 beaters, 2 dough hooks, whisk attachment included.
strengths: 220W motor handles thick cookie dough at speed 3 for 3 minutes without warming
Storage case fits all five attachments plus the mixer with cord stowed
9-speed range gives finer graduated control building meringue than 5-speed rivals
Dough hooks are genuinely functional for 1 to 2 cup flour bread and pizza dough
Complete kit costs less than buying a KitchenAid mixer plus separate hooks and whisk
limitations: Beater bowl coverage is narrower than KitchenAid, needs a scrape around the 2-minute mark
Heavier than the KitchenAid at 2.7 pounds
Whisk attachment is less aerated than a stand mixer balloon whisk
Storage case lid can be stiff when new
features: 2 beaters, 2 dough hooks, whisk attachment included
Compact storage case for all attachments plus mixer

products.name: Breville BHM800SIL Handy Mix Scraper Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: Scraper beaters that contact the bowl wall each rotation, 240W motor, Digital on-body speed display.
strengths: Scraper beaters eliminated manual bowl-scraping entirely through a full cake batter cycle
240W motor is among the strongest in the hand mixer category
Digital speed readout is useful for recipes with specific speed calls
Reduces manual scraping interruptions from 3 to 4 down to 0 to 1 per batch
limitations: 2.9 lb weight causes noticeable fatigue during extended high-speed sessions
Only 5 speeds despite the premium price
features: Scraper beaters that contact the bowl wall each rotation

strengths: Whisk is genuinely effective for whipped cream and egg whites

Ergonomics are functional but not premium

features: Genuinely slow speed 1 for flour incorporation without spray
